## Data Generation Process

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# this is the table for example 1

table1 <- data.frame(
  col1 = c("Block", "", "Unit(block)", "Total"),
  col2 = c( 4, "", 25, 29),
  col3 = c("", "Treatment", "", ""),
  col4 = c("", 5, "", ""),
  col5 = c("Block", "Treatment", "Unit(block)|Ttr*", "Total"),
  col6 = c(4, 5, '25-5=20', 29)
)

kable(table1, col.names = NULL,  format = "html") |> 
  add_header_above(rep(c("Source", "df"), 3), align = "l") |> 
  add_header_above(c("Study Design" = 2, "Treatment Design" = 2, "Combined" = 2)) |> 
  row_spec(4, bold = TRUE) |> 
  kable_styling(full_width = TRUE, position = "center")#|> 
 # footnote("*Unit-within-block effects after accounting for treatment effects.")

```

::: {style="font-size: 75%;"}

*a table footnote because `knitr::footnote()` formats incorrectly when rendered by Quarto. Delete this subs4ection if you don't need a table footnote
